description: Reads estimated glucose values on a timer and pushes them downstream exactly as Dexcom returns them. Refreshes the access token when it ages out and persists the new pair. Holds no cursor: it reads a trailing window, because where to resume depends on what the consumer does with the data.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, to read. 300000 is five minutes, which matches how often a CGM produces a value.

config.label: Lookback Minutes
config.description: How far back each read reaches. Overlapping windows are expected: de-duplicating is the consumer's job, since only it knows what has already been handled.

config.label: Environment
config.description: Which Dexcom environment to talk to: sandbox or production. They are separate hosts with separate credentials, so a production key against sandbox fails in a way that looks like a bad secret.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The Client ID from your Dexcom application registration. Left blank on purpose: fill it in after import.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: The Client Secret from your Dexcom application registration. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Redirect URI
config.description: Where Dexcom sends the browser after sign-in. Must match the Dexcom registration exactly, character for character, and must be https.

config.label: Base URL Override
config.description: Leave blank to use the host implied by Environment. Set a full base URL only to point at a mock or a proxy.

config.label: Token Store Path
config.description: SQLite file holding the authorized token pair, relative to the Linkiir working directory. Dexcom only offers a user-authorized grant, so the tokens have to outlive the request that obtained them.

config.label: Request Timeout
config.description: Seconds to wait for a Dexcom response.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Verify Dexcom's certificate. Leave on; turn off only against a local mock.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are prepared but never sent, and calls report themselves as simulated. Lets an imported adapter be inspected before it touches a real account.
